scenes.headline: Writing without one letter
scenes.sub: Why a mask garbles a model and training fixes it
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Reeve! Today: why deleting every token with an e leaves a model babbling, and how training teaches it to write around the gap.

scenes.text: A mask removes the letter, but not the plan that needed it. So the model must be trained to plan words that never need an e.
scenes.say: A mask removes the letter, but not the plan that needed it. The model has to learn to plan words that never need an e.

steps.say: The model reads the prompt and scores every token in its vocabulary.
The mask sets the score of every token containing an e to minus infinity. Nearly a third of the vocabulary goes.
The sampler picks from what is left. That can be a word piece the model never planned.
The piece joins the text, and the next step has to continue from it.

left.title: Mask only
left.say: With only the mask, no answer has an e. But the model still plans words that need one, and the mask breaks them mid way, so you get riddiculous, riddiculous, riddiculous.

right.title: Mask plus training
right.say: After training under the mask, the model picks words that never need an e in the first place.

items.say: Pick four prompts from the pool.
Sample eight answers for each, with the mask on.
A judge scores every answer for sense and for answering the prompt.
Subtract the group average, so only answers that beat their siblings are pushed up.
Update a small adapter, and repeat.

scenes.title: Usable answers, share of 200
scenes.note: the writeup's measured figures, judged by a model
scenes.say: The writeup reports twenty-six percent usable with the mask alone. Training from examples first, then reinforcement learning, reaches sixty and a half.

scenes.text: The mask handles the letter. Training handles the writing.
scenes.say: The thing to remember: the mask handles the letter, and training handles the writing.

recap: A mask bans tokens, not plans
scenes.say: The letter lives inside tokens, a mask bans tokens but not plans, and training teaches the plan.
